craft_notes: Sthāyin: first positive state (after two denials). Sanskrit: antaḥsvānubhavānandā + vikalponmuktagocarā + bhāritākārā → L4 = L3 line (shared-set allowed — L4 may set L3). Rows: row 1 (state named whole). Close: self (possessive). Rejected: 'beatitude' — killed: joy kept; 'capacity' — killed: full-formed kept.

lines: Joy within — inner self-taste, unhoused in fancy:
that full-formed state — Bhairavī of Bhairava's self.
l4.sanskrit_cite: antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What state is Bhairavī? → Bhairavī's state is inner-joy beyond fancy — full-formed.
c1_essence: Inner self-taste joy: Bhairavī's full-formed state.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
